result.summary: This residential intersection features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. While traffic volumes appear low, the absence of formal crossing points and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles create risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, failing to provide a designated path for pedestrians or a visual cue for drivers.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Curb
hazards.description: There are no curb ramps at the intersection corners, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large parked truck near the corner may block the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian infrastructure. While the low-density residential setting suggests lower traffic volumes, the wide, unmarked roadway and lack of traffic control for the primary approach create an environment where pedestrian priority is not established.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no designated space or visual cue for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the street light

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible for the main approach, which may lead to higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Evaluate the intersection for stop sign installation to regulate traffic flow and improve safety for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street corner with a sidewalk but no marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The absence of curb ramps and crosswalk markings, combined with parked vehicles near the intersection, creates a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the street at this intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, making it inaccessible for wheelchair users or those with strollers.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection corner may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
